The bed rails do not meet structural stability or retention strap requirements, posing a fall hazard. Additionally, the bed rails’ push pins and push pin holes are incorrectly sized, posing a laceration hazard.
original.why_it_matters: Relevant because it involves loss of life and public safety. Published by an official/primary source (U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission); independent coverage not yet found.
